line: Crowley on Atu XIII: the letter Nun, Scorpio ruled by Mars, the dance of death, and Atu XIII and XV from Tiphareth (pdf p90, p91, p95).

sections.title: Letter and sign
sections.line: Crowley refers the card to the letter Nun, a fish, and to the sign of Scorpio, ruled by Mars (pdf p90).

quotes.quote: This card is attributed to the letter Nun, which means a fish;
It refers to the Zodiacal sign of Scorpio, which is ruled by Mars,

sections.title: Atu XIII and XV on the Tree
sections.line: Crowley on Atu XIII and XV, symmetrically placed on the Tree of Life and leading from Tiphareth (pdf p95), and on the Paths that join the ten numbers (pdf p36).

quotes.quote: On the Tree of Life, Atu XIII and XV are symmetrically placed; they lead from Tiphareth, the human consciousness, to the spheres in which Thought (on the one hand) and Bliss (on the other) are developed.

sections.title: The dance of death
sections.line: Crowley on the card as the dance of death, the figure a skeleton bearing a scythe (pdf p91), and as the symbol of life beneath the waters (pdf p90).

quotes.quote: The card itself represents the dance of death; the figure is a skeleton bearing a scythe,
the symbol of life beneath the waters; life travelling through the waters.
